partners.mechanism_chain: FLNA (HGNC:3774) —DISRUPTS→ Cytoskeletal regulation (GO:0007010); Cytoskeletal regulation (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Skeletal abnormalities (HP:0004408); ITGB3 (HGNC:6024) —DISRUPTS→ Platelet aggregation (GO:0007540); ITGA2B (HGNC:6022) —DISRUPTS→ Platelet aggregation (GO:0007540); Platelet aggregation (GO:0007540) —LEADS_TO→ Thrombasthenia (HP:0001889); Cytoskeletal regulation (GO:0007010) —BINDS→ Platelet aggregation (GO:0007540). Loss-of-function mutations in FLNA disrupt cytoskeletal regulation, leading to skeletal abnormalities seen in Melnick-Needles syndrome. Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in ITGB3 or ITGA2B disrupt the integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 complex, impairing platelet aggregation and causing Glanzmann thrombasthenia. The convergence lies in the shared impact on cellular adhesion and cytoskeletal dynamics, where FLNA's role in linking the cytoskeleton to cell surface proteins is essential, and the ITGA2B/ITGB3 complex is a key mediator of outside-in signaling that influences the cytoskeleton.
